subject: rsvp
angle: How to read your numbers the week before the event
caption:
"When do we stop waiting for replies" is usually seven days out when your caterer asks for final headcounts.

· Unopened links mean you need a direct text
· Pending meals mean they are still coming
· Confirmed counts go straight to your caterer
· QR codes on paper cards track late replies

Send us your wedding date and expected guest count to get your own live RSVP site.
